entry.text: Project Name :  Web Scraping & Data Automaion in Azure & API Development
Technologies : Python, Azure Data Factory, DataBricks, Django, Selenium,
Tools used :  VS code, Git, IIS server, MySQL, Postman,
Web Scraping and Data Automation
• Designed and implemented end-to-end data pipelines, utilizing Azure Data Factory, to transform raw data
into actionable insights.
• Employed Azure Databricks and PySpark for advanced data processing and analytics, ensuring optimal
performance and scalability.
• Spearheaded the development and implementation of storage solutions, utilizing Azure Data Lake
Gen2, and Azure SQL . These efforts resulted in a 50% reduction in data retrieval time and improved
overall system performance.
• Designed and implemented sophisticated web scraping solutions using advanced Python libraries
including BeautifulSoup, Requests, and Selenium WebDriver.
• Developed robust data extraction frameworks capable of scraping complex websites with multiple
layers of pagination and dynamic content.
• Created custom scraping scripts to extract structured data from diverse sources, including Startup
company websites, financial websites and Insurance company websites.
• Implemented intelligent scraping techniques to handle:
• Dynamic content loaded via JavaScript
• Websites with complex authentication mechanisms
• Anti-scraping protection and rate limiting
• Developed proxy rotation and user-agent switching mechanisms to ensure consistent and
uninterrupted data collection.

entry.text: Project 3 – Shravas Technologies IT India Pvt Ltd, Bangalore
Python Development and Data Processing in Azure Cloud
• Designed and implemented efficient data pipelines using  Azure Data Factory, and  Databricks to
transform raw  data from  source to mart layers, resulting in  a 40%  reduction in  processing time and
improved decision- making.
• Spearheaded the development and implementation of storage solutions, utilizing Azure Data Lake Gen2,
and Azure SQL . These efforts  resulted in a 50% reduction in data retrieval time and improved overall
system performance.
• Built end-to-end Python applications with focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
• Developed data processing pipelines to transform raw scraped data into clean, structured formats
using Pandas and NumPy.
• Created automated workflows for:
• Data cleaning and preprocessing
• Advanced data transformation
• Statistical analysis and visualization
• Implemented efficient data storage solutions using:
• SQL databases (MySQL, SQLite)
• Excel file and JSON file formats
• Developed RESTful APIs using Django Rest framework to expose scraped and processed data.
